blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Ahead of Undas, or the All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day holidays, Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso on Friday issued reminders to the public, who intend to visit the Manila North Cemetery. During an inspection led by the mayor at the cemetery, Domagoso told potential visitors what not to bring and what not to do when visiting the memorial park.
